title: ShelfReport
description: DRAFT, needs all four signatures. What a shelf label shows, and how it is. Published to retail/shelf/{label_id} by the edge (Layer 2) each time a label checks in. QoS 1, not retained: a retained sighting would replay to a reconnecting dashboard as if the label had just been seen. Subscribed to by dashboard-api, which keeps the history.

label_id.description: Must equal the {label_id} segment of the topic it is published on.

product_id.description: The product the label is assigned to, or null if none.

price.description: The price on the glass, or null if it shows none or the edge cannot tell which. Two decimal places. Consumers must parse as decimal, never float.

decision_id.description: The decision behind the price on the glass, from the PriceUpdate the edge delivered. Null for a manager-set price with no proposal, or when the edge does not know it.

in_sync.description: The glass shows the current retained retail/price/{product_id}.

rendered_at.description: UTC ISO-8601. The first check-in at which the label reported showing this price. Accurate to the check-in interval: a sleeping label cannot report sooner.

rssi_dbm.description: How strongly the edge heard the label.

battery_pct.description: Estimated from battery voltage on a LiPo curve, so about plus or minus 10. Null when unknown, for example while the label runs on USB.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601. When the edge heard this check-in.
